notes.title: Update notice
notes.notes:
1.1.0 update notice

Hello, steam players. Here's new news for you. In view of the lack of feedback from players and the boring game, the production team decided to make a new version. The main contents of the new version are as follows:

1. Carry out a lot of game reconstruction in filling.

2. Optimize the playability of game fish.

As the game is a large version, the production cycle will be longer. The production team will work overtime to bring new content to you. The specific online time will be announced separately. (≧▽≦)
